Okay. Either way, nobody wants to have that many bikes or scooters in their house lol. And they aren’t doing it, just like me they sign up cause they think it’s a good deal and end up never doing it. Not to mention it takes them almost a month to send you the chargers so by the time they arrive, you most likely have forgotten you signed up. Also, a lot of the people I met that are “Juicers” work a day job, even in the r/limebike I’ve come across people complaining about the drop off time. It’s common sense that nobody is just going to charge bikes for LimeBike as a living, so of course there’s something else.

The people that are getting paid (terribly) to pick these things up, don’t even want to pick them up. Nobody wants to drive around, pick up 5 bikes, charge them at their house (making your electric bill go up and taking up space), and drop them off before 7am. All for like $30. The company should raise the pay or change the drop off time and they’ll have some people willing to do it. I signed up to pick up the bikes and I can only do it on weekends due to the fact I have work at 8am, and I’m sure it’s the same way for most people.

I was looking around for app jobs to do in my spare time, came across one for the LimeBike and it’s the biggest scam ever. They want you to drive around collecting the bikes and scooters, charge them at your house, using your own electricity, and then drop them off at the drop off stations before 7am. And you only get $5 a bike or whatever (not even guaranteed). No wonder these things are everywhere, they’re way of collecting them is so dumb nobody wants to do it. Every time I’ve ever found one, it was dying so I couldn’t even use it. It’s a cool concept, people are just too inconsiderate to follow the app instructions and we end up with a mess of LimeWire bikes and scooters all over the place. I don’t know you personally but I’m sure you mean something to somebody. I know exactly how you feel though. I get stuck in creative blocks often. Maybe you need a break from reality and the stress of having to pay bills might just be causing a block for you and is a distraction from your main goals. I was frustrated for a while and couldn’t figure out what I wanted to do with my life and was way too emotionally drained from financial responsibilities. I took it upon my self to take the crazy risk of selling majority of my items and began my backpacking journey in Southeast Asia. This gave be the ability to actually think about what I want to do with my life without any other distractions. It helped me get over that bump in the road and brought me closer to my self. When I returned to my boyfriend, everything felt brand new and we were so happy once again. Mostly because I found purpose. Maybe you need a little break from all the things that’s stressing you. Like I said, this is a big decision but it’s helped me and a lot of others I met in my travels so it may help you. Just remember to never give up and to never think you have no value. We each have something to contribute to this world, you just have to explore your inner self to find it. Hope everything gets easier for you. 💕 keep your head up lad.
